description: Source of truth for active SET-TRANSLATION items and exact-value retirement of obsolete managed English overrides. Consumed by tools/branding/apply-brand-strings.php.
why_this_file_exists: In OpenEMR the English source string IS the catalogue key (library/translation.inc.php:39-77 looks the literal up in lang_constants by exact match). Editing the literal inside xlt() therefore ORPHANS every existing translation of that string. RebrandingBugs.md RB-01 measured 59 translations destroyed that way. SET-TRANSLATION items must be delivered as catalogue data, never as a source edit. xl() consults lang_id=1 (English (Standard)) exactly like any other language -- there is no English short-circuit -- so an English row rebrands the UI while leaving every other locale intact.

english_overrides.note: The bare product name as a translation constant. Distinct from the SessionUtil session-cookie name 'OpenEMR', which is a frozen machine identifier under locked Q17/C6 and is NOT a translation constant -- nothing here touches it.

retired_english_overrides.reason: All former OAuth consumers now compose applicationTitle with the translatable Authorization phrase. Delete only the exact managed lang_id=1 row; preserve custom and non-English definitions.
The former OAuth login consumer now composes applicationTitle with the translatable Login phrase. Delete only the exact managed lang_id=1 row; preserve custom and non-English definitions.

deliberately_not_changed.reason: Contains no product name. Its Arabic translation ('الولوج الي بوابة المريض') is a pre-existing upstream row and is already correct. Nothing to rebrand.

sql_patch.php places the product name OUTSIDE the xlt() call, so the constant itself never contained a brand name and the rename did not touch the catalogue. This is the pattern the other call sites should have followed.

deliberately_not_changed.constant: OpenEMR 400 Error / OpenEMR 404 Error / OpenEMR Error
deliberately_not_changed.reason: Already edited in source by commit b866c5358. Verified against the live catalogue: these constants have ZERO rows in lang_definitions in any language, so the rename destroyed nothing. Left as-is rather than reverted, but recorded here so the mechanism inconsistency is visible and is not cited as precedent.
